_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N352355 (2025-09-03, dev split; picked: China-held): CBP held China. Product drafted by gemini-4-argon from the facts, reviewed by hand. Target Vietnam; plant capabilities for Vietnam are an assumption. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Deal Worthy 4,000 mAh power bank, model number PB41
product.description: A portable battery for charging electronic devices with a nominal capacity of 4,000 mAh and a nominal energy of 14.8 Wh. It consists of two cylindrical lithium-ion battery cells and a printed circuit board assembly enclosed in an injection molded plastic case with a plastic button, light guide, light shield, USB-A output connector, and micro-USB input connector, packaged with a charging cable.

components.name: Printed circuit board assembly (with a USB-A and a micro-USB connector)
Injection molded case (bottom and top cases)

operations.name: Solder wires to the printed circuit board assembly
Weld a nickel strip to two battery cells
Weld the wires from the printed circuit board assembly to the battery cells
Place the PCBA and battery cell assembly inside the bottom case with a pre-installed button, light guide, and light shield
Test, inspect, and package the device with the charging cable
